frozenQuestion: Do the Figure 4 efficiency rankings reproduce under successful swaps alone and the publication swap-plus-comparison projection, and how do they change under the complete clean-room reference operation ledger?

freezeBoundary.qualification: S09 had already disclosed endpoint, trajectory, and accepted-swap results, including the Selection swap contrast. The S10 cost projections, publication-ratio equivalence margins, full-ledger rankings, and comparison/read outcomes were frozen before those S10 outcomes were summarized.
freezeBoundary.sourcePopulation: Reuse every declared no-fault paper_scale and confirmatory_holdout run from S09; launch no replacement simulations and make no post hoc exclusions.

paperScale.purpose: Figure 4 reconstruction and bounded historical z-formula reconstructions

confirmatory.purpose: Primary paired effects, equivalence tests, and ranking sensitivity

analysisPopulations.protectedSplitRule: Only paper_scale and confirmatory_holdout rows already admitted by the S09 preregistration may be analyzed; exploratory and policy_search_holdout remain forbidden.

costConventions.swapOnly: acceptedSwaps for R; successful recorded swaps for C
costConventions.publicationSwapPlusComparisonR: acceptedSwaps + valueComparisons under the S03 logical comparison convention
costConventions.publicationSourceProjectionC: successful recorded swaps + frozen StatusProbe compare_and_swap_count; retain as source-specific and non-parity because the probe is not a logical comparison count
costConventions.targetCalculationsR: Exactly one target-selection calculation per no-fault proposal/activation, including boundary and terminal-policy NoOp proposals; therefore targetCalculations equals proposals in the S10 no-fault population. This is an S10 derived operation convention, not a new S03 state counter.
costConventions.rejectedActionsR: rejections + conflictLosses; policy NoOps are reported separately and are not reclassified as rejections
costConventions.unitWeightFullLedgerR: activations + observationReads + valueComparisons + targetCalculations + proposals + noOps + rejections + memoryUpdates + acceptedSwaps + displacedCells + conflictLosses. This is a transparent sensitivity projection of overlapping unit operations, not a physical or privileged cost.
costConventions.wallTime: Report elapsed seconds separately by backend, split, condition, and architecture; never add wall time to an algorithmic cost or use it for cross-backend inference.

pairedEffects.orientation: cell_view minus traditional for differences and cell_view divided by traditional for ratios
effectSizes: paired standardized mean difference dz when the paired SD is nonzero
pairedEffects.uncertainty: 10000 deterministic paired bootstrap resamples; report ordinary 95 percent and six-claim Bonferroni-adjusted 99.1667 percent intervals for the six Figure 4 cost-definition claims.

equivalenceTests.method: Bootstrap TOST by confidence-interval inclusion on the ratio of paired condition means. Report nominal 90 percent and six-claim Bonferroni-adjusted 98.3333 percent intervals; confirm equivalence only when the adjusted interval is wholly inside the frozen bounds.
equivalenceTests.bounds: Multiplicative bounds are target * (1 - relativeMargin) through target * (1 + relativeMargin).

historicalZReconstruction.status: historical sensitivity analysis only; never confirmatory inference
historicalZReconstruction.interpretation: Because the paper does not specify pairing, variance estimator, sidedness, multiplicity, or raw inputs, neither candidate is represented as the paper's recovered test. Undefined zero-standard-error cases remain undefined.

claimClassification.supportive: The confirmatory reference effect has the paper-reported direction and the adjusted equivalence interval lies inside the frozen paper-target bounds.
claimClassification.approximatelyReproduced: The direction is reproduced but adjusted equivalence to the paper target fails.
claimClassification.notReproduced: The adjusted paired interval excludes the paper-reported direction or the ratio is on the opposite side of one.
claimClassification.notTestableHistorically: Required historical traditional arrays or operation fields are unavailable.

validation: R ledger identities and C source-counter identities
complete paper and confirmatory pairing and run accounting
explicit null plus availability reason for every unavailable historical field
